item.title: 3 men set for lethal injection on same day in Tennessee, Alabama and Oklahoma
item.description: Three inmates in Tennessee, Alabama, and Oklahoma are scheduled for execution Thursday. If all proceed, it will be the first time in nearly 16 years that three executions occur on the same day in the U.S.
